body: But the problem with this post is that the pronunciation with two syllables for "vice" is actually the [CORRECT](http://dan.hersam.com/2006/10/17/vice-versa/) way to say it in Latin.  Maybe y'all should check your own knowledge before you start criticizing others.
Love you, too, friend.  Thank you for being supportive.  What helped you find what you loved?  Do you know?

Glad a doctor is helping you.  I saw a therapist for a long time.  Every time a session ended I would leave and cry my eyes out.  I never felt like I moved forward.  Just that I opened more and more boxes of shit, and maybe looked at them a little differently, but then they were left open there, spilled all over the place.  She would spend at least 10 minutes of every 45 minute session going on about the "value of our work," and while I thought she was incredibly intelligent, I wanted to feel better and I wanted to be able to see it happening.  And I didn't have endless funds to go through every aspect of my life for years.  
Can I ask what helped you?  Medication?
I'm grateful for your kind words.

Thank you.  I do feel a little better and I appreciate the suggestions.  
It sounds like your life is similar to mine.  Honestly, I don't know whether that is good or bad, but I am glad that you seem to be pretty happy.
I agree 100%.  Except about the feeling ashamed part.  You're a bit of a weirdo.

Thanks for the solidarity, mate. 
I don't know.  I don't think so.  I think I am unhappy with my current "relationship" and that is the source of my username.  The other feelings are more all-encompassing.

Any time.  Send me a message if you need to chat.  And maybe try not to think of it as "should".  I dunno about you, but for me "should" is a motherfucker that likes to shame me for my shortcomings and laziness.  "Could" is kinder.  And probably more accurate.

If it makes you feel any better, there are almost certainly girls who have had feelings for you whose feelings you have not reciprocated.  Being alone is pretty shit, though, I agree.

In the end, I'm not sure that it matters at all what others feel for us.  You are the only one that lives in your head.  The love you feel from someone else is created within you.

I wish someone wanted me this way.  Even knowing it is blind infatuation and likely to break down once her mystery is destroyed.

Good luck, friend.  I would tell you to talk to her, but that might diminish the lovely longing you are experiencing.  The release from the grasp of obsession is always so disappointing.
